reference_title: GSA Alternate Path Analysis and Design Guidelines for Progressive Collapse Resistance (October 24, 2013, Revision 1, January 28, 2016)
scope_note: Full-manual coverage (50 printed pages, main body). Chapters 1-8 body text extracted (chapter01.json through chapter08.json). Chapter 3 (Design Procedures) is the largest chapter and its content is split across two Python modules: alternate_path.py (Sections 3.1-3.3, the sole Alternate Path design procedure -- Tie Forces and Enhanced Local Resistance are both removed in their entirety) and redundancy.py (Section 3.4, entirely NEW content with no UFC 4-023-03 analog) -- equation_module below names alternate_path.py as the primary module for that chapter entry. Appendix A (references) is NOT extracted as chapter text. Appendix B (definitions, narrative) and Appendix C (commentary, narrative) are likewise not extracted as chapter text -- Appendix C's Table C1.1 IS digitized directly in structural_steel.py. Appendix D (reinforced-concrete worked example) is used as a validation anchor in reinforced_concrete.py/redundancy.py tests, not re-narrated as chapter text. Appendix E (structural-steel worked example) is not transcribed or cataloged at all. The figure catalog covers Chapter 2's applicability flow chart, all 15 surviving Chapter 3 figures (3.1-3.6 removed with the Tie Forces section), all 8 Appendix B figures, all 6 Appendix C figures, and the 5 Appendix D building-geometry figures (35 total, all page-confirmed).
